builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Neeko: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (488 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 50.4% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A deceptive pick mage who combines disguises and clones with root setup and a delayed area engage. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Hextech Rocketbelt → Zhonya's Hourglass → Stormsurge. Arcane Comet keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Ionian Boots of Lucidity, Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, Morellonomicon.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Hextech Rocketbelt → Zhonya's Hourglass → Stormsurge, with Arcane Comet.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Hextech Rocketbelt → Zhonya's Hourglass → Stormsurge) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 50.4% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Hextech Rocketbelt → Zhonya's Hourglass → Stormsurge.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Every 3rd Attack deals an additional [30 / 65 / 100 / 135 / 170 + (0.6) × AP] bonus magic damage and increases Neeko's Move Speed by [10 / 17.5 / 25 / 32.5 / 40]% for [1] second.

Active: Neeko becomes invisible for [0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5] seconds and projects a clone that lasts [3] seconds. Neeko and the clone gain [20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40]% Move Speed for [3] seconds. 

The clone can be controlled using the Move Pet Click hotkey or by Recasting this Ability.
The clone mirrors her spellcasts, emotes, and recall.

After a delay Neeko leaps into the air, Knocking Up all nearby enemies for [0.6 / 0.6 / 0.6] seconds. She then crashes down, dealing [150 / 350 / 550 + (1.2) × AP] magic damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for [0.75 / 0.75 / 0.75] seconds.

This Ability can be prepared in secret if Neeko is disguised. [0.5] seconds after casting this ability Neeko breaks her disguise.

Neeko throws a seed that blooms to deal [60 / 110 / 160 / 210 / 260 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. If it kills a unit or hits a champion or large monster, it will bloom again, dealing [35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage. Max 2 extra blooms.

Neeko can disguise herself as other units on the map. At any time she can disguise as an allied champion, or Neeko can stand next to any allied or neutral unit to store their Sho'ma and be able to transform into it. Your disguise will break upon receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting a damaging spell, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar. 

Neeko gains many of the properties of the units she turns into, negative and positive.

Neeko slings a tangle that deals [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage and Roots for [0.7 / 0.9 / 1.1 / 1.3 / 1.5] seconds.

The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for [2 / 2.25 / 2.5 / 2.75 / 3] seconds.

builds.name: Third-hit control
builds.summary: Use W's third attack as the payoff of a controlled attack window.
builds.goal: Use W's third attack as the payoff of a controlled attack window.
builds.hypothesis: W's every-third-attack magic packet has 0.6 AP and grants speed. Nashor plus Rageblade tests attack cadence; Terminus supports mixed ordinary attack and W damage after ramp. E's empowered root can provide the time to deliver the third attack.
testPlan: Required state: Recorded W counter and enough contact to ramp Rageblade and Terminus.
Count actual attacks between W packets with Rageblade off and fully stacked, then repeat after target switching.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A target switch or disengage removes the third-hit payoff and defensive ramp.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Phantom hits are not automatically extra W attack-counter increments.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Survive the engage
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Neeko: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A deceptive pick mage who combines disguises and clones with root setup and a delayed area engage. Compare disguise/R access with empowered W attacks. Record actual attack cadence and passive effects; an AP attack route cannot assume every hit is empowered. A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
builds.summary: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
testPlan: Kit question for Neeko: Compare disguise/R access with empowered W attacks. Record actual attack cadence and passive effects; an AP attack route cannot assume every hit is empowered.

Start with the early core (Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.

The route fails Neeko's stated kit question: Compare disguise/R access with empowered W attacks. Record actual attack cadence and passive effects; an AP attack route cannot assume every hit is empowered.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.
Full cost 16,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Banshee's Veil, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Void Staff are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Hidden ultimate aura
builds.summary: Convert a disguised approach into a brief contact damage window.
builds.goal: Convert a disguised approach into a brief contact damage window.
builds.hypothesis: Disguise hides part of R preparation but breaks 0.5 seconds after cast. R's knockup and stun can hold targets near Zeke's ultimate-triggered storm; Rocketbelt helps approach and Abyssal increases nearby magic damage. Zhonya offers survival after the committed entrance.
testPlan: Required state: A credible disguise, R ready and enemies inside the landing radius.
Measure R hit count, storm contact seconds and survival for visible versus disguised approach.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Early crowd control breaks disguise or displacement leaves the aura without targets.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The W clone mirrors casts without proving it deals their damage or carries items.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.

Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
